pages.name: Capacity & staffing
pages.storyNote: How much bed capacity exists, where it sits, and who staffs it.

visuals.title: Total bed capacity
visuals.altText: Total licensed beds across every hospital in the current filter.

visuals.subtext: Beds are the constraint that everything else is measured against. Compare ward mix and department mix before reading clinical activity.

visuals.title: Which ward types hold the beds
visuals.altText: Bed count for each ward type, sorted from largest to smallest.

visuals.title: How beds are spread across department types
visuals.altText: Bed count for each department type, sorted from largest to smallest.

visuals.title: Which hospitals carry the capacity
visuals.altText: Licensed bed capacity for each hospital, sorted from largest to smallest.

visuals.title: Department detail
visuals.altText: Bed count and ward count for every department.

pages.name: Clinical activity
pages.storyNote: What the wards actually do: procedures, lab work and medication administration.

visuals.subtext: These are volume counts. They say what was done, not how well: read them against bed capacity rather than as quality measures.

visuals.title: Which medication categories are administered most
visuals.altText: Medication administration count by medication category, sorted from most to least.

visuals.title: How nursing staff spreads across ward types
visuals.altText: Nurse count by ward type, sorted from most to least.

visuals.title: Which device types are deployed
visuals.altText: Medical device count by device type, sorted from most to least.
